description: plx.investigate with inline plans (the plan argument, format plx-investigate-plan/v1) on fresh BC roots for an authorized MANAGER: the five worked examples of ontology/plans/_inline_examples.json, three a planner writes for questions no stored family answers (a supplier's open orders past due, the items on an order with nothing received, the documents linked to a shipment) and two it gets wrong (a link type the schema does not declare, a property the type does not have). operating.host cycles (Host.cycle: a GET-only BC capture of the named entity sets into a throwaway host state in {tmp}, then the projection build) on the BC-only host configuration scripts.live_employee_tools writes beside that state (no Portal, mail or SharePoint configured), then the host's served tools as the reader staff:manager with the example MANAGER clearance (clearance_source names examples/employee_permission_policy.example.json, never a production clearance). Each plan runs on up to 3 projected roots of its root types (the investigate check's sampling, never an eval item) and records the investigate family stats under plans.<id> plus outcomes per root: answered_cited, answered_uncited (no claim: a filter nothing matched, a stage on a source not configured) or refused:<error code>. An outcome other than the example's expect (answered, or the typed refusal plan_undeclared_link / plan_unknown_property it names) counts in plans_unexpected. Every checked claim passes (claim_uncited 0, roots_failed 0), the outsider with no grant gets no value and no claim (outsider_leaks 0), every plan reaches a root and the shipment plan checks a claim; with no BC record projected, or a plan whose root sets BC answered empty, the check names sources_blocked. Every answer is validated against its frozen contract. Output is counts, booleans, codes and states only; never a value, number, name, identifier or citation.
notes: Evidence: injected-transport tests (tests/test_live_employee_tools.py, the BC fake of integrations/tests/test_bc_capture.py); live-unverified until the live check records a result on the real BC captures. The inline plans are data (ontology/plans/_inline_examples.json): a new example runs with no script edit, but its plans.<id> floors are this spec's.
